name: calculation_engine
description: Performs safe math operations and financial calculations including growth rates, margins, ROE, current ratio, and Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) valuation models.

operation.description: The math or financial operation to perform.

operands.description: The numbers to operate on (e.g. [base, current] for growth_rate; [revenue, COGS] for gross_margin).

projected_cash_flows.description: List of projected cash flows for DCF calculation.

discount_rate.description: Discount rate / WACC for DCF (e.g. 0.08 for 8%).

terminal_growth_rate.description: Terminal perpetual growth rate for DCF (e.g. 0.025 for 2.5%).

net_debt.description: Net debt (Total Debt - Cash) for DCF equity value calculation.

shares_outstanding.description: Number of shares outstanding for DCF per-share intrinsic value.
